# Synthetic dashboard fixtures

Generated by `scripts/prepare_dashboard_fixtures.py` through the real CLI service
(`evaluate_bundle`) and `compare_reports`. Everything is artificial: scenario
`SCN-999`, host `synthetic-host`, rule IDs `900001`/`900002`, the reviewer label
`synthetic-reviewer` and its attestation. No lab data, no source incident, no
claim of detection coverage. `scenarios/` ground truth is unchanged.

| File | What it shows |
| --- | --- |
| `before-false-negative.json` | run with activity but no alert, plus a synthetic `complete_for_scope` declaration → `False negative`, `caller-attested` |
| `after-detected.json` | same scenario with the alert → `Detected`, witness pair, `timeline` with two events |
| `comparison-regression-passed.json` | `compare_reports(before, after)` → `Regression Passed` (A01 `unchanged_pass`, A02 `improvement`) |
| `malformed-truncated.json` | JSON cut mid-object → server answers 422, dashboard shows the malformed state |
| `unsupported-kind.json` | valid JSON whose `kind` is neither `evaluation` nor `comparison` → 422 with field `kind` |

Regenerate with:

```powershell
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts\prepare_dashboard_fixtures.py
```

The script prints the SHA-256 of every file it wrote. Review the diff before
committing a regenerated set; never hand-edit verdicts or attestations.
